articles.title: PM Modi lays foundation stone of Foxconn-HCL chip plant in Jewar; says ‘Made in India chip’ vital for developed India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi laid the foundation for a significant semiconductor chip manufacturing plant in Jewar, Uttar Pradesh. This joint venture between Foxconn and HCL aims to produce "Made in India" chips, critically boosting the nation's electronics manufacturing capabilities. It marks a crucial stride towards technological self-reliance and strengthening the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, enhancing India's position in global tech supply chains.

articles.title: WBSSC mandates slippers for Group C, D exams: Covered shoes not allowed at centres, details here
articles.summary: The West Bengal Staff Selection Commission (WBSSC) has mandated a new dress code for its Group C and D examinations. Candidates are now required to wear slippers to the exam centres, with all forms of covered footwear strictly prohibited. This measure is implemented to bolster exam security and mitigate the chances of unfair practices, ensuring a more transparent and equitable examination process for all aspirants across the state.
